articles.summary: HANGZHOU, China, Oct. 23, 2024 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Kaixin Holdings (“Kaixin” or the “Company”) (NASDAQ: KXIN) today announced that it will effect a share consolidation of its ordinary shares at a ratio of 1-for-60, effective on October 25, 2024 (the “Share Consolidation”).
articles.title: Kaixin Holdings Announces Share Consolidation
